name: G 风格回火 V3 · 压力爆破
design_note: Reference-guided pressure-pulse candidate; three phase-aligned, strongly damped OSC plus two broad noise bands. Reduced high-band excitation; no new voice, DSP kernel, filter, room or PCM. Frequencies/decays remain sound-design parameters, not identified physical modes. Listening pending.

reference_evidence.limits: Visible flames support exhaust-event selection. Mixed vehicle audio, microphone/codec and propagation remain; pedal, RPM and exact A/V offset are not measured. Parameters are sound-design choices, not source-separated estimates.

supersedes_feedback: V2 sounds too crisp, insufficient impulsive pressure/explosive body; user 2026-11-18.
